title: IPSafe

description.en: Check your network connection before letting a command run.
description.zh: 在执行命令之前，先确认网络连接符合预期。

subject: A green network cable tester with a short patch lead

source.description: Validate network connectivity before executing commands `npm i -g ipsafe`

palette.source: Adopted IPSafe presentation, 2026-09-07-01/01; background.base in archived settings.json

subject.en: A green network cable tester with a short patch lead
subject.zh: 带短跳线的绿色网线测试仪

description.en: A compact cable tester holds a short patch lead close to two ports. Three small status lights identify a completed connectivity check before the next command.
description.zh: 紧凑网线测试仪用短跳线连接两端口，三颗小状态灯表现下一条命令执行前已经通过的连接检查。

description.en: Green molded rubber surrounds a brushed charcoal face. Opaque cream cable and smoky connectors remain physical; the large loop opening is transparent.
description.zh: 绿色模压橡胶包覆拉丝深灰面板，象牙色线缆与烟灰接头保留实体质感，大线圈镂空透明。

description.en: Paired port rectangles, guarded chevron lanes and three short status bars in quiet mint paper. The field, grain and contact shadow are independent of transparent app marks.
description.zh: 薄荷色纸面上的成对端口、保护通道折线和三条状态短线。 底色、颗粒与接触阴影均独立于透明应用标记。

palette.source: Adopted IPSafe presentation, 2026-09-07-01/01; background.base in archived settings.json

sizeNote.en: At 128/64 px, the dark tester and cream cable loop remain clear. At 32/24/16 px, the compact silhouette and dominant colors carry recognition; fine material detail, printed marks and background lines naturally merge.
sizeNote.zh: 128/64 px 能辨认深色测试仪与象牙色线圈；32/24/16 px 以紧凑轮廓和主色维持识别，精细材质、印记与背景线条自然合并。

goal.en: Check that a configured URL returns a successful HTTP response and optionally matches response content before starting a command, with project or user configuration and reusable Node.js APIs.
goal.zh: 在启动命令前，确认指定 URL 返回成功响应并按需匹配内容；支持项目或用户配置，以及可复用的 Node.js API。

role.zh: 单元与 CLI 模拟测试

description.en: Paired port outlines, guarded chevron lanes and short status bars describe a connection being checked.
description.zh: 成对端口、折向通道与短状态条，描出一次正在核验的连接。

alt.en: A green network cable tester with a short patch lead on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 带短跳线的绿色网线测试仪，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

caption.zh: 先确认连接，再安心执行。

description.en: Green network cable tester with a short patch lead.
description.zh: 带短跳线的绿色网线测试仪。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥75px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 75px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
